card.summary: H.R. 7726 amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act of 1990 and the Richard B. Russell National School Lunch Act to increase integrity, accountability, and fraud prevention measures. It requires the Secretary to investigate fraud, permanently debar child care providers and food program institutions found to have committed fraud, impose sanctions on noncompliant states, require corrective action plans or conditional ineligibility for states with improper payment rates over five percent, establish periodic monitoring and high-risk designations, and mandates a GAO study on fraud prevention.
